entities.summary: Flavio Cobolli is an Italian professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 13 achieved on 30 March 2026 and a doubles ranking of No. 185 reached on 28 July 2025. He is currently the Italian No. 3 in men's singles.
